# Slice E: Notifications & Invoicing Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Send WhatsApp notifications to club owners when a booking is created, and build the invoice tracking view in the dashboard.

**Architecture:** A thin WhatsApp client wraps the Meta Cloud API. It is called from the POST /api/bookings route after a booking is confirmed. Invoice records are generated by a server action that scans confirmed (non-no-show) bookings in a date range. The invoice dashboard shows current and past invoices per club.

**Tech Stack:** Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (fetch), Next.js Server Actions, Prisma

**Prerequisite:** Slice A, C, and D complete.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement WhatsApp client**

```typescript
// src/lib/whatsapp.ts
type NotificationParams = {
  toPhone:    string;
  clubName:   string;
  guestName:  string;
  date:       string;
  startTime:  string;
  tableNames: string[];
};

export async function sendBookingNotification(params: NotificationParams): Promise<void> {
  const token     = process.env.WHATSAPP_API_TOKEN;
  const phoneId   = process.env.WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID;

  if (!token || !phoneId) {
    // Silently skip in dev when credentials aren't configured
    console.log("[WhatsApp] Skipping — WHATSAPP_API_TOKEN or WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID not set");
    return;
  }

  const body = {
    messaging_product: "whatsapp",
    to: params.toPhone.replace(/\s+/g, ""),
    type: "text",
    text: {
      body:
        `🎱 New booking at ${params.clubName}\n\n` +
        `Guest: ${params.guestName}\n` +
        `Date: ${params.date} at ${params.startTime}\n` +
        `Tables: ${params.tableNames.join(", ")}`,
    },
  };

  const res = await fetch(
    `https://graph.facebook.com/v19.0/${phoneId}/messages`,
    {
      method:  "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization:  `Bearer ${token}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    },
  );

  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    console.error("[WhatsApp] Send failed:", err);
  }
}
```

### Task 2: Wire WhatsApp into booking creation

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app/api/bookings/route.ts`

- [ ] **Step 1: Update POST /api/bookings**

Replace the `POST` handler in `src/app/api/bookings/route.ts`:

```typescript
// src/app/api/bookings/route.ts
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { CreateBookingSchema } from "@/lib/validations";
import { createBooking, getUnavailableTableIds } from "@/lib/data/bookings";
import { sendBookingNotification } from "@/lib/whatsapp";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const body = await req.json();
  const parsed = CreateBookingSchema.safeParse(body);

  if (!parsed.success) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: parsed.error.flatten() }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const { clubId, slotDurationId, tableIds, date, startTime } = parsed.data;

  const unavailable = await getUnavailableTableIds({ clubId, date, startTime, slotDurationId });
  const conflict = tableIds.some((id) => unavailable.includes(id));
  if (conflict) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "One or more selected tables are no longer available. Please try different times." },
      { status: 409 },
    );
  }

  const booking = await createBooking(parsed.data);

  // Fire-and-forget WhatsApp notification to the club owner
  const club = await db.club.findUnique({
    where: { id: clubId },
    select: { name: true, whatsappId: true },
  });

  if (club?.whatsappId) {
    const tableNames = booking.bookingTables.map((bt) => bt.table.name);
    sendBookingNotification({
      toPhone:    club.whatsappId,
      clubName:   club.name,
      guestName:  booking.guestName,
      date,
      startTime,
      tableNames,
    }).catch(console.error);
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ bookingId: booking.id }, { status: 201 });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement invoices data layer**

```typescript
// src/lib/data/invoices.ts
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function generateInvoice(params: {
  clubId:         string;
  periodStart:    string;
  periodEnd:      string;
  commissionRate: number;
}) {
  const { clubId, periodStart, periodEnd, commissionRate } = params;

  const bookings = await db.booking.findMany({
    where: {
      clubId,
      date: {
        gte: new Date(periodStart),
        lte: new Date(periodEnd),
      },
      status: "CONFIRMED",
    },
    include: {
      bookingTables: { include: { table: true } },
      slotDuration: true,
    },
  });

  const bookingCount = bookings.length;
  const grossRevenue = bookings.reduce((sum, b) => {
    const tableTotal = b.bookingTables.reduce((s, bt) => s + bt.table.pricePerSlot, 0);
    return sum + tableTotal;
  }, 0);
  const totalAmount = grossRevenue * commissionRate;

  return db.invoice.create({
    data: {
      clubId,
      periodStart: new Date(periodStart),
      periodEnd:   new Date(periodEnd),
      bookingCount,
      commissionRate,
      totalAmount,
      status: "PENDING",
    },
  });
}

export async function getInvoicesForClub(clubId: string) {
  return db.invoice.findMany({
    where: { clubId },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
  });
}
```

### Task 4: Invoice API route

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/api/dashboard/invoices/route.ts`

- [ ] **Step 1: Implement generate endpoint**

```typescript
// src/app/api/dashboard/invoices/route.ts
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { auth } from "@/lib/auth";
import { generateInvoice, getInvoicesForClub } from "@/lib/data/invoices";
import { z } from "zod";

const GenerateSchema = z.object({
  periodStart:    z.string().regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/),
  periodEnd:      z.string().regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/),
  commissionRate: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.1),
});

export async function GET(_req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await auth();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const invoices = await getInvoicesForClub(session.user.clubId);
  return NextResponse.json(invoices);
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await auth();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const parsed = GenerateSchema.safeParse(await req.json());
  if (!parsed.success) return NextResponse.json({ error: parsed.error.flatten() }, { status: 400 });

  const invoice = await generateInvoice({ clubId: session.user.clubId, ...parsed.data });
  return NextResponse.json(invoice, { status: 201 });
}
```

```typescript
// src/app/(dashboard)/dashboard/invoices/page.tsx
import { auth } from "@/lib/auth";
import { getInvoicesForClub } from "@/lib/data/invoices";
import { GenerateInvoiceForm } from "@/components/dashboard/GenerateInvoiceForm";

export default async function InvoicesPage() {
  const session  = await auth();
  const invoices = await getInvoicesForClub(session!.user.clubId);

  return (
    <div>
      <h1 className="font-serif text-2xl font-bold text-brand">Invoices</h1>
      <div className="mt-6 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-sm">
        <table className="w-full text-sm">
          <thead className="bg-gray-50 text-left">
            <tr>
              {["Period", "Bookings", "Commission", "Amount", "Status"].map((h) => (
                <th key={h} className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-gray-600">{h}</th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {invoices.map((inv) => (
              <tr key={inv.id} className="hover:bg-gray-50">
                <td className="px-4 py-3">
                  {new Date(inv.periodStart).toLocaleDateString("en-LK")} —{" "}
                  {new Date(inv.periodEnd).toLocaleDateString("en-LK")}
                </td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3">{inv.bookingCount}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3">{(inv.commissionRate * 100).toFixed(0)}%</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">LKR {inv.totalAmount.toLocaleString()}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3">
                  <span className={`inline-block rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium ${
                    inv.status === "PAID"    ? "bg-green-100 text-green-800" :
                    inv.status === "SENT"    ? "bg-blue-100 text-blue-800" :
                    "bg-amber-100 text-amber-800"
                  }`}>
                    {inv.status}
                  </span>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
        {invoices.length === 0 && (
          <p className="py-12 text-center text-sm text-gray-400">No invoices yet.</p>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-8">
        <h2 className="mb-4 font-serif text-lg font-semibold text-brand">Generate invoice</h2>
        <GenerateInvoiceForm />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: GenerateInvoiceForm client component**

```typescript
// src/components/dashboard/GenerateInvoiceForm.tsx
"use client";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";

export function GenerateInvoiceForm() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    const form = new FormData(e.currentTarget);
    await fetch("/api/dashboard/invoices", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        periodStart: form.get("periodStart"),
        periodEnd:   form.get("periodEnd"),
      }),
    });
    setLoading(false);
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 items-end">
      <div>
        <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600">Period start</label>
        <input name="periodStart" type="date" required className="rounded-lg border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand focus:outline-none" />
      </div>
      <div>
        <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600">Period end</label>
        <input name="periodEnd" type="date" required className="rounded-lg border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand focus:outline-none" />
      </div>
      <button type="submit" disabled={loading} className="rounded-lg bg-brand px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-light disabled:opacity-60">
        {loading ? "Generating…" : "Generate"}
      </button>
    </form>
  );
}
```
